title: Why do the Jets own the top pick in the second round of the 2026 NFL Draft?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why do the Jets own the top pick in the second round of the 2026 NFL Draft?
sources.description: The Jets own the second pick in first round the 2026 NFL Draft. However, the team also has the top pick in the second round. You might be wondering why this is. The Jets finished at 3-14 in 2025. That tied them with the Raiders, Cardinals, and Titans for the worst record in the league. […]
